decision: Reject this naive CPU-compatible Q8_0 MXFP4 down batch implementation for performance. It passes fixed-text top1 exactly, including full down coverage, but a strict cold France n96 run timed out at 420s, far below SOTA requirements. Source was reverted; keep the result as correctness scaffold evidence only.
interpretation: The Q8_0 math path fixes correctness (max_abs=0 in top1 verifier) but the naive scalar/output-column kernel and per-call H2D Q8_0 staging are too slow. Next source work should port/reuse the existing moe_stream.cu hot-batch rowtile/warp Q8_0 CPU-compatible kernels into the batch cache path, or implement a tiled kernel with shared Q8_0 rows and coalesced expert loads.
next_step: Design optimized Q8_0 down batch v2: row-tile/warp kernel, reduce per-output-thread serial 2048 loop cost, keep same API/default-off gate, rerun top1 first, then strict cold performance.
